baseline_models.focus_anchor: The interrogative "did he fabricate against God a lie, or is there madness in him?" is overturned by "rather, those who do not believe in the hereafter."
baseline_models.mechanism: The first clause offers a closed diagnosis of the messenger: deliberate false construction or reason covered by madness. The adversative rejects both horns and relocates the diagnostic problem in the accusers' refusal to entrust the later horizon, so their act of classification becomes evidence of their own deviation.

activation_trace.role: Fabricated falsehood supplies the first horn as intentional construction of an untruth.
Contradiction of truth specifies what the alleged construction is said to produce.
Reason covered by madness supplies the second horn as impaired rather than intentional speech.
Heart-settling assent identifies the rejected hereafter as the accusers' own failed epistemic act.
Laterness after the first gives the disputed report its deferred horizon.
Departure from guidance turns the accusation back into a diagnosis of the accusers' orientation.

changed_reading.before: The speaker must be either lying about resurrection or mentally impaired.
changed_reading.after: The binary diagnosis is itself rejected: refusal to trust the later horizon discloses the accusers, not the messenger, as badly oriented.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The accusers are described locatively as "in the punishment and the far error," not only as people who will later receive them.
baseline_models.mechanism: The locative construction places them within a present condition whose full consequence belongs to the later horizon. Punishment, hiddenness or loss, and distance form an enclosure that impairs recognition now; futurity is the disclosure of a condition already inhabited rather than its simple beginning.

activation_trace.role: Deferral to a later time supplies the horizon across which the present condition will become manifest.
Painful punishment supplies the consequential environment in which the verse locates the unbelievers.
Hiddenness and disappearance make error a condition that can conceal itself from its inhabitant.
Distance from nearness gives the error a spatial and epistemic geometry.

changed_reading.before: The verse predicts future punishment and labels the accusers generically misguided.
changed_reading.after: It depicts them as already enclosed in a self-concealing, distance-producing condition whose punitive reality is disclosed across the later horizon.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The adjacent roots of fabrication, lying, and madness also carry images of stitching, a deceptive garment, and covering.
baseline_models.mechanism: A branch-level material model treats falsehood as an assembled cover: pieces are cut and joined into an appearance that conceals rather than reveals. On this reading, the accusation says the messenger has fitted such a cover over speech about God, while the adversative raises the possibility that the accusers' own binary is the fitted cover.

activation_trace.role: Cutting for repair and stitching supplies fabrication as the joining of selected pieces into a made surface.
A garment that deceives by its condition supplies the false appearance produced by that assembly.
Covering from perception supplies concealment as the assembled surface's functional effect.

changed_reading.before: Fabrication is simply inventing a false proposition.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, fabrication is selective assembly into a plausible covering, and the verse reverses the question of whose representation is doing the covering.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence puts total material tearing beside new creation, surrounds it with knowledge of what is hidden down to every particle, and then asks the deniers to see the field around them. This revises "far error" into a perceptual inference: what has dispersed beyond sight is treated as beyond recovery, although hiddenness and distance do not place it outside knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Disappearance within something supplies the focus error's mistaken equation of invisibility with nonexistence.
Distance supplies the focus diagnosis as a failure of access and orientation.
What is screened from eyes supplies the hidden domain that nevertheless remains exhaustively known in the ayah.
Tearing into scattered pieces supplies the material state from which the mockers infer non-recoverability.
Newness occurring after a cutting supplies the counter-image in which discontinuity can precede renewed creation.
Seeing by eye and insight supplies the demanded corrective to inference from what is no longer visible.

structural_cues: 34:3 denies that even a particle, smaller or larger, escapes knowledge or the clear record.
34:7 places total tearing and new creation inside the mockers' own report.
34:9 immediately asks them to inspect what lies before and behind them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden particles, tearing followed by newness, and a demand to see; I infer that the mockers move from dispersal and invisibility to impossibility of return. A live alternative is that 34:9 only threatens them and does not expose the logic of their denial.

changed_reading.before: Far error is a general doctrinal distance from belief in resurrection.
changed_reading.after: Far error is specifically the bad inference that matter dispersed beyond sight has also escaped knowledge, measure, and recoverability.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Davidic craft sequence turns resistant iron pliant and orders linked armor by measure; the Saba sequence turns measured, secure routes into requested distance and then total fragmentation. Together they activate a join-versus-break mechanism in the focus: constructive fabrication measures and connects pieces, whereas far error asks for separation until the social body is torn.

activation_trace.role: Cutting for repair and stitching anchors the focus verb to constructive assembly as well as accusatory invention.
Softness opposed to rough resistance supplies the material transition that makes reworking possible.
Hard iron supplies the resistant material that is transformed rather than discarded.
Deliberate measured ordering supplies the rule by which separate parts become a sound whole.
Piercing and linking rings or hide supplies the concrete image of joined discrete pieces.
Actively creating distance supplies the choice that reverses secure connection into separation.
Tearing and scattering into pieces supplies the social result of requested distance and echoes 34:7.

structural_cues: 34:10-11 moves from hard iron through softening and measure to connected armor.
34:18-19 moves from measured secure travel through a request for greater distance to total fragmentation.
The exact tearing formula in 34:19 echoes the resurrection mockery in 34:7.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two ordered transformations and the repeated tearing formula; I map their material and social arrows onto the focus contrast between fabrication and far error. The live alternative is that the craft and Saba sequences are independent exempla rather than a commentary on the accusation's wording.

changed_reading.before: Fabrication is verbal invention, while far error is an abstract moral distance.
changed_reading.after: The accusation misnames ordered reassembly as false fabrication, while the accusers' own orientation acts as anti-linkage: it produces distance, breaks measured relations, and ends in fragmentation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah distinguishes madness from actual hidden beings, then denies that those beings possess hidden knowledge when a material collapse exposes their ignorance; it later distinguishes worship of them from belief in them. The focus's madness label therefore reads less as an explanation than as an opaque causal attribution whose evidential warrant has not been tested.

activation_trace.role: Covering of reason by madness supplies the accusers' proposed hidden cause of the messenger's speech.
Actually hidden beings supply a distinct, observable category whose work does not entail knowledge of the hidden.
Emergence into visibility supplies the disclosure produced by the collapse of a material support.
The hidden beings become the subjects whose epistemic limitation is exposed.
What is screened from eyes supplies the knowledge those beings demonstrably lacked.
Assent directed toward the jinn supplies a later example of commitment to a hidden-agent account.

structural_cues: 34:12 presents jinn as workers under permission rather than autonomous knowers.
34:14 lets an ordinary material event reveal that the jinn did not know the unseen.
34:41 separately names worship of jinn and belief in them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical recurrence, observable work, a material disclosure, and denied unseen knowledge; I infer a critique of using an unseen mental cause to explain away unusual speech. Alternatively, the later passages may only disambiguate jinn from madness without commenting on standards of diagnosis.

changed_reading.before: The second horn straightforwardly alleges insanity.
changed_reading.after: It also exposes an evidential maneuver: absence of an answer is hidden behind a causal label, while the surah insists that claims about hidden agency remain answerable to disclosed effects.

context_deltas.mechanism: A conjecture becomes true through being followed, doubt distinguishes the nonbeliever, guidance is obstructed, disbelief is commanded continuously, regret is concealed, and the process terminates in collars. Far error is thus not only private confusion; it is a distributed loop in which suggestion recruits following, hierarchy maintains obstruction, and repeated compliance hardens into constraint.

activation_trace.role: Assent that settles the heart anchors the focus failure whose social production the later sequence exposes.
The later horizon supplies the object around which following and doubt divide the community.
Departure from guidance anchors the resulting network as error rather than neutral affiliation.
Uncertain supposition supplies the initiating expectation that gains force through response.
Following in another's track supplies the behavior by which conjecture realizes itself.
Two possibilities interpenetrating without settled certainty supplies the unstable state opposed to hereafter belief.
Turning and diverting supplies the leaders' disputed role in blocking access to guidance.
Demand backed by obligation supplies the interpersonal pressure to disbelieve.
Hiding something inwardly supplies regret that remains concealed until punishment is seen.
A collar that binds the body supplies the terminal materialization of socially maintained constraint.

structural_cues: 34:21 explicitly denies Satan coercive authority, preserving responsibility inside the social mechanism.
34:31-33 stages reciprocal blame between the weakened and the self-exalting.
34:33 locates the scheme across night and day before hidden regret and collars appear.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies conjecture, following, denied coercive authority, reciprocal blame, commands, concealment, and collars; I infer a causal loop from suggestion through social reinforcement to constraint. The alternative is a simpler moral sequence in which each item is parallel evidence of guilt rather than a single mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Not believing in the hereafter is an isolated intellectual failure.
changed_reading.after: The far error is socially inhabited: uncertain suggestion becomes an apparently confirmed world through following, obstruction, command, and concealed complicity, without eliminating individual responsibility.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus alleges that the messenger attaches a lie to God. Later, unsupported claims about beings besides God are stripped of ownership and participation, the accusers are asked to display those they have attached as partners, and clear recitation is again called an inverted, fabricated falsehood. The predicate "fabricated against God" therefore rebounds as a projection from their own attachments onto the message that challenges them.

activation_trace.role: Fabricated falsehood anchors the charge whose agency is progressively reversed.
Contradiction of truth supplies the alleged content attached to God.
The worshipped God supplies the object against whom the false attachment is alleged.
Speech without certainty supplies the accusers' own unsupported claim about other powers.
Ownership and disposal supply the capacity explicitly denied to the claimed powers.
Participation supplies the share in cosmic agency explicitly denied to them.
Attaching an entity to an affiliation supplies the accusers' act of joining partners to God.
Association with God names the status produced by that attachment.
Turning a thing away from its proper direction supplies the inversion by which clear signs are renamed falsehood.
The repeated fabricated-falsehood formula shows the focus charge becoming a stock response to recited signs.

structural_cues: 34:22 tests the claimed powers by ownership, participation, and support.
34:27 asks the accusers to show the partners they attached to God.
34:43 repeats fabricated falsehood while linking the challenge to inherited worship.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unsupported claims, denied capacities, attached partners, and the repeated accusation; I infer rhetorical projection from the accusers' own additive theology onto the message. The alternative is that the passages merely refute two separate propositions without assigning the same fabrication mechanism to both.

changed_reading.before: The verse records a one-off allegation that the resurrection report was falsely attributed to God.
changed_reading.after: The allegation is a recurrent defensive inversion: people who attach unsupported partners and inherited commitments to God call the dislodging message the attached falsehood.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later repetition of "there is no madness in your companion" is preceded by a procedure: rise for God, in pairs and individually, then think. Pairing and solitude vary the social conditions of judgment, while long companionship supplies an evidential history. The focus's lie-or-madness binary is therefore answered not by a counter-label but by a method for checking it.

activation_trace.role: Reason covered by madness anchors the diagnosis that the later procedure tests.
Rising with resolve supplies the deliberate break from passive group repetition.
Joining one person to one supplies a small reciprocal setting for checking judgment.
The solitary individual supplies an independent setting free from immediate group reinforcement.
The heart's repeated consideration supplies the cognitive work replacing instant diagnosis.
Sustained companionship supplies accumulated observable evidence about the accused person.
The exact madness sense is repeated under negation as the conclusion of the prescribed examination.

structural_cues: 34:46 repeats the focus phrase about madness almost verbatim under negation.
The order is commitment, paired and solitary examination, reflection, then judgment about the familiar companion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies paired and solitary settings, thought, companionship, and the repeated negated diagnosis; I infer a de-biasing procedure that checks both crowd contagion and solitary self-confirmation. Alternatively, pairs and individuals may simply universalize the exhortation rather than prescribe distinct epistemic controls.

changed_reading.before: The adversative simply asserts that the accusers, not the messenger, are wrong.
changed_reading.after: The surah later operationalizes that reversal: suspend the crowd's binary, vary the social setting, inspect the known person, and think before assigning hidden pathology.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence contrasts God casting truth with people casting speech at the unseen from a distant place. Guidance arrives by hidden communication from a Lord described as near; capture is from near, but belated belief cannot be reached from far, and a barrier finally blocks desire. "Far error" becomes an epistemic trajectory: unsupported verbal projection creates distance until access to the desired correction fails.

activation_trace.role: Departure from the intended path anchors the closing sequence as the anatomy of error.
Distance from nearness anchors the focus adjective to the closing access geometry.
Casting words supplies the authorized projection of truth that opens the final contrast.
The speaker's conditional personal erring supplies accountable ownership rather than diagnostic projection onto others.
Knowledge imparted in hidden form supplies the channel by which guidance reaches the speaker.
Nearness opposed to distance places the hearing Lord close to the guided speaker.
Failure of attainment or escape supplies the collapse of access at the moment of alarm.
Nearness supplies the place from which accountability reaches them despite their epistemic distance.
Extending to take and reach supplies the now-impossible retrieval of belief.
Distance supplies the position from which belated assent cannot be grasped.
Casting words and accusations supplies their speculative counterpart to the truthful casting in 34:48.
What is screened from sight supplies the target at which they throw claims without access.
The repeated distant place makes their speech's epistemic position explicit.
A barrier separating two things supplies the final hardening of distance into blocked desire.

structural_cues: 34:48 and 34:53 repeat the same casting verb with truth and the unseen as contrasting objects.
34:50 places personal error against guidance by hidden communication and ends with nearness.
34:51-54 alternate near capture, distant failed retrieval, distant speculation, and final separation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored casting, near guidance and capture, distant speculation and failed retrieval, and a terminal barrier; I infer a trajectory in which speech without access produces the distance it presumes. The alternative is that the near/far language is only eschatological timing and place, not a model of present knowing.

changed_reading.before: Far error means severe or extensive moral deviation.
changed_reading.after: Far error is a position produced by throwing claims toward what one cannot access; it grows into practical non-retrievability even while truth, hearing, and accountability remain near.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus form and syntax strongly support fabrication from ف ر ي, while the packet also preserves a non-dominant ف ت ر target. It remains packet-anchored and changes the accusation's mechanism, but downstream prose should present it only as split-root associative pressure, never as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The first horn "أفترى" maps in the packet not only to ف ر ي but also to the non-dominant ف ت ر inventory.

activation_trace.role: Weakening and stillness after intensity supply a form-distant image of lapse or attenuation within the first accusation.
Covered reason supplies the second horn and lets the split-root image blur the accusers' sharp moral-versus-medical binary.

changed_reading.before: The alternatives are cleanly separated as intentional lying or madness.
changed_reading.after: At the packet's split-root edge, the first horn also carries a faint image of lapse after intensity, exposing the accusation as a continuum of depreciative labels rather than a stable diagnosis.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-material reading is surprising because it links distant branch images rather than lexical senses in one clause. It remains anchored in the focus's deceptive-garment and protective-cover branches and gains a visible armor-to-collar sequence in context; render it as a qualified analogy about rhetorical function, not as word meaning.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus juxtaposes a lie branch imaged as a deceptive garment with a madness root that also contains protective covering.

activation_trace.role: A garment that misrepresents its condition supplies accusation as a surface that deceives while covering.
A protective shield supplies the accusation's defensive function against the disturbing resurrection report.
A long, ample covering supplies the context's beneficial form of complete protection.
A collar binding the body supplies the reversal in which defensive enclosure hardens into restraint.

changed_reading.before: Calling the report a lie or madness merely dismisses it.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the dismissal functions as protective rhetorical clothing: it screens the accusers from the report, but the same enclosing logic eventually appears as a bond rather than protection.

strongest_changes: The tearing/newness sequence makes resurrection denial a mistaken equation of dispersal with irrecoverable loss.
Measured linked craft and Saba's requested distance turn fabrication versus far error into a coherent joining-versus-fragmentation mechanism.
The repeated madness phrase is answered by paired and solitary reflection on a known companion, replacing a label with a checking procedure.
The closing mirrored casting and near/far sequence turns far error into failed epistemic access produced by speculation at the unseen.
Unsupported partners and the repeated fabricated-falsehood charge make the focus accusation rebound as projection.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence preserves unusually exact relays: total tearing in 34:7 and 34:19, madness in 34:8 and 34:46, fabricated falsehood in 34:8 and 34:43, active distance in 34:19 and inaccessible distance in 34:52-53, and truthful versus speculative casting in 34:48 and 34:53. These relays convert a compact rebuttal into material, social, procedural, and spatial mechanisms without forcing them into one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The cutting-and-linking craft model is strongly branch-anchored but depends on a reader-supplied analogy across separated exempla.
The projection model is rhetorically coherent, but the packet does not itself state that the accusers consciously transfer their own fabrication.
The hidden-agent model may be lexical disambiguation rather than an implicit standard for diagnosis.
Both outliers are deliberately branch-distant and should remain qualified activations rather than lexical claims.
